mapper.select: SELECT emp54_errand_id AS errandId , emp54_date AS date , emp54_weekday AS weekday , emp54_person_info AS personInfo , emp54_errand_nm AS errandName , emp54_depart_time AS departTime , emp54_return_time AS returnTime , emp54_reason AS reason , emp54_venue AS venue , emp54_host AS host , emp54_note AS note , emp54_appr_id AS apprId , emp54_apr_status_nm AS aprStatusName FROM ( SELECT emp54_errand.* , f_cdnm('ErrandCode', emp54_errand_cd, emp54_company_id, emp54_date) AS emp54_errand_nm , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, apr01_company_id, apr01_reg_date) AS emp54_apr_status_nm , emp00_kor_nm AS emp54_person_nm , emp00_org_code_nm AS emp54_org_nm , emp00_kor_nm ||'('|| emp00_org_code_nm ||')' AS emp54_person_info , sys12_weekday AS emp54_weekday FROM emp54_errand INNER JOIN LATERAL getPerson(emp54_company_id, emp54_date) ON ( emp00_person_id = emp54_person_id AND emp00_trans_cd NOT IN ('800','900') ) INNER JOIN sys12_calendar ON ( sys12_company_id = emp54_company_id AND sys12_day::date = emp54_date ) LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = emp54_appr_id WHERE emp54_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp54_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{closeDate} ) t WHERE CONCAT(emp54_person_info, emp54_errand_nm, emp54_reason, emp54_host) ILIKE #{searchText} ORDER BY emp54_date DESC, emp54_depart_time, emp54_return_time
